purpose: Import a user-supplied AI-generated video and compose verified Quranic text and rights-cleared recitation without treating the imported video as a search result.

inputContract.userInputRights: The user must have the necessary rights to every uploaded input and reference asset.

serviceNotes.runway: Current Runway help states users retain ownership and rights in content they upload and generate, including commercial use; provider attribution is not formally required.
serviceNotes.luma: Commercial use depends on the active subscription tier; Free/Lite generations are personal-use only, while qualifying paid plans grant commercial usage rights.
serviceNotes.canva: Canva states users own Output to the extent permitted by law, but Licensed Content and AI-generated audio are subject to specific terms; outputs may not be unique.
